**About Reaviva Holistic Health** 




  





 Reaviva Holistic Health is a premium, science led wellness sanctuary in Santacruz West, Mumbai, offering integrated solutions across aesthetics, fitness, recovery, nutrition and mental well\-being. We are committed to personalised care and an exceptional client experience in a sophisticated environment.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are looking for an Associate Sales Manager to own client conversion at the clinic. You will work the enquiry pipeline across telephone, WhatsApp and digital channels, qualify every lead, and convert enquiries into booked consultations and consultations into treatment packages.
 



  





 This is a client facing position at the centre of the business. You will carry an individual revenue target, and you will also be the first point of contact for clients arriving at the clinic, managing the appointment book and the client experience alongside your pipeline. The role suits someone equally confident receiving a client in person and closing a package on the telephone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 1\. Place outbound calls to new leads within the agreed response time, and complete the full follow up cadence for enquiries that do not connect at the first attempt
 



 2\. Respond to enquiries across calls, WhatsApp and direct messages, progressing the pipeline through the working day
 



 3\. Manage incoming calls and walk in enquiries with the same qualification discipline applied to digital leads
 



 4\. Qualify enquiries through structured discovery and convert them into booked consultations
 



 5\. Improve the booked to attended ratio through timely reminders, rapport building and pre consultation preparation
 



 6\. Prepare clients ahead of their consultation and hand over to the clinical team with complete context, so that every consultation begins informed
 



 7\. Introduce complementary services where relevant to the client, and book consultations for the clinical team to advise and recommend
 



 8\. Conduct structured reach out campaigns to dormant client segments and contribute to monthly reactivation revenue
 



 9\. Record every client interaction, update enquiry stages promptly, and maintain database accuracy to the required standard
 



  





 Client experience at the clinic
 



  





 10\. Receive clients on arrival with the warmth and polish of a luxury wellness environment, manage the appointment book, and keep waiting times minimal and clearly communicated
 



 11\. Process billing and payments accurately, and record every amount received against the correct client, service and package
 



 12\. Coordinate between clients, therapists and doctors so that each day runs to schedule and every transition between services is seamless
 



 13\. Operate the clinic management system accurately and in real time across appointments, client records, billing and packages
 



 14\. Maintain the reception area, displays and client facing materials to the standard of the brand
 



 15\. Uphold the confidentiality, discretion and presentation standards expected of a premium clinical environment
 



  





 Performance and standards
 



  





 16\. Submit a daily performance update and participate in weekly funnel reviews with the sales team
 



 17\. Deliver against monthly performance targets covering revenue contribution, enquiry connection, qualification, consultation bookings, attendance rate, walk in conversion and database reactivation
 



 18\. Represent Reaviva in a manner that is informed, courteous and consultative at all times
 



  





 Requirements
 



  





 Two to four years in a client facing sales role within luxury services, wellness, aesthetics, hospitality or premium retail
 



  





 A record of carrying an individual revenue target, supported by specific examples of what was achieved and how
 



  





 Hands on working experience with an operational clinic, spa or salon management system such as Zenoti, covering appointment scheduling, client records, billing and package management. Working knowledge of a sales CRM is a further advantage
 



  





 Excellent spoken English, delivered with clarity, warmth and conviction
 



  





 Excellent written communication in English across WhatsApp and email, together with correct telephone etiquette
 



  





 A consultative approach to selling, based on establishing trust rather than applying pressure
 



  





 Willingness to work at the clinic and in front of clients for the full working day
 



  





 The ability to manage concurrent responsibilities, attending to a client in person while progressing follow ups, without compromising either
 



  





 Accuracy and discipline in billing, cash handling and record keeping
 



  





 A composed and presentable manner, particularly at times of high footfall
 



  





 A structured approach to problem solving where process is still being established
 



  





 Resilience and consistency in a target led environment with weekly reporting
 



  





 Preferred Background
 



  





 Client servicing or guest relations experience in a premium hotel, spa or clinic, followed by a move into a selling role, is the strongest background for this position. Candidates from luxury brands, wellness, beauty or aesthetics are equally encouraged to apply, and prior exposure to high net worth clientele in a service led environment will be considered a significant advantage. Candidates whose experience is limited to telephone based inside sales may find this position less suitable.
 



  





 What We Offer
 



  





 A front line position in a growing premium wellness brand, with ownership of the client experience from first contact to closed package
 



  





 A monthly incentive linked to revenue, in addition to fixed compensation
 



  





 A defined progression path to senior and leadership positions for consistent performers
 



  





 A collaborative working environment with direct access to leadership
 



  





 Additional Details
 



  





 Location: Santacruz West, Linking Road, Mumbai
 



  





 Working Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM
 



  





 Working Pattern: Full time and on site, six days a week with one weekly off on rotation. The clinic is open all days
 



  





 Start Date: Immediate
 



  





 Compensation: Discussed at interview
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Please apply through LinkedIn with your curriculum vitae and a brief covering note. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an on site discussion.

This role will work within a focused revenue team and contribute directly to market reach, qualified pipeline, and growth. The company values people who can take responsibility for outcomes, learn quickly, and communicate confidently with business decision\-makers. Because the team is growing, this opportunity suits someone who wants meaningful ownership rather than a narrowly defined activity\-based role. You will engage with businesses, understand their priorities, and create relevant conversations for the sales organisation. The role is based onsite in Navi Mumbai and offers the chance to build a strong foundation in B2B SaaS and FinTech sales while working closely with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Own the top of the B2B SaaS sales funnel through targeted prospecting, qualification, meeting scheduling, and structured follow\-up. You will use LinkedIn, outbound email, cold calling, and prospecting tools to reach CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior leaders. Success is measured by qualified prospects progressing to scheduled demos, with demos delivered by Account Executives and supported by strong SDR preparation. You will qualify business needs, provide useful context to the Account Executive, ensure prospects attend scheduled meetings, and continue follow\-ups after the demo to support opportunity progression. The role requires disciplined CRM usage, confident communication, strong data quality, and ownership of the prospect journey from first contact through post\-demo follow\-up.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists across relevant B2B segments, using account research and defined ideal\-customer criteria to improve outreach relevance and create stronger sales coverage.
* Execute multi\-channel outbound campaigns through LinkedIn, personalised emails, and cold calls, owning response quality, qualification, meeting conversion, and contribution to qualified pipeline.
* Engage confidently with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and senior management by connecting business challenges to relevant SaaS and payments solutions.
* Research accounts and identify accurate decision\-makers, extracting phone numbers and email addresses through approved prospecting and data\-enrichment tools to improve contactability.
* Qualify prospects against agreed business, urgency, authority, need, and fit criteria, then schedule qualified demos for Account Executives with complete and accurate meeting context.
* Prepare Account Executives for scheduled demos by documenting prospect needs, stakeholders, use cases, objections, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Manage meeting confirmations, reminders, rescheduling, attendance, and timely follow\-ups so qualified prospects progress reliably through the sales process.
* Follow up with prospects after Account Executive demos, capture feedback and next steps, maintain momentum, and support conversion of qualified meetings into active opportunities.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Proven B2B SaaS outbound prospecting experience, with the ability to create qualified pipeline through disciplined LinkedIn outreach, email sequences, cold calling, and account\-based research.
* Strong executive communication skills, including confidence speaking with CFOs, HR heads, CXOs, and other senior decision\-makers in concise, commercially relevant conversations.
* Practical experience building prospect lists and using LinkedIn, CRM platforms, email tools, databases, and contact\-enrichment systems to identify and verify business contacts.
* Strong understanding of qualification, discovery, objection handling, meeting scheduling, demo preparation, attendance management, and post\-demo follow\-up within a sales development process.
* Clear written communication for personalised email messaging, LinkedIn outreach, call scripts, meeting confirmations, follow\-ups, and concise Account Executive handoffs.
* Analytical and process\-oriented approach to measuring outreach, qualification, scheduled demos, attendance, post\-demo engagement, data quality, and pipeline contribution.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience selling FinTech, payments, HR technology, payroll, finance, or adjacent B2B SaaS solutions to mid\-market or enterprise organisations.
* Familiarity with sales engagement, CRM, LinkedIn automation, email verification, lead enrichment, and intent\-data tools used responsibly within outbound prospecting workflows.
* Existing understanding of CFO, HR, finance, or people\-operations priorities, enabling more relevant qualification and follow\-up with functional and executive stakeholders.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Three to four years of hands\-on experience in B2B SaaS sales development, outbound business development, lead generation, or a closely related role with measurable qualified\-meeting and pipeline outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to source accounts, identify relevant contacts, build prospect lists, qualify business needs, and execute consistent outreach across LinkedIn, email, and phone channels.
* Confidence communicating with senior business leaders, especially CFOs and HR heads, while adapting messaging to their priorities and earning credible demo conversations for Account Executives.
* Ownership mindset, resilience, and operating discipline: you follow through before and after demos, maintain accurate CRM records, and improve conversion through response and meeting data.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Bizpay offers the opportunity to take visible ownership of revenue creation inside a growing FinTech and payments SaaS business. In a team of 11–50 people, your work will be closely connected to commercial outcomes, giving you direct exposure to sales strategy, customer needs, and the systems that turn market interest into qualified demos and pipeline. This is a role for someone who wants to do more than execute scripts. You will shape target lists, test messaging, qualify business problems, schedule meetings for Account Executives, and maintain momentum after demos. You will use performance data to improve qualification, attendance, and conversion. The onsite setup in Navi Mumbai supports close collaboration with sales leadership and faster learning through real customer conversations. You will also build valuable experience across B2B SaaS, payments, finance, and HR\-related business problems. The company provides a setting where initiative is visible, high\-quality execution matters, and strong performers can grow with the business as its market reach expands.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A visible revenue ownership opportunity within a growing FinTech and payments SaaS company, with direct responsibility for qualified demos, pipeline contribution, and prospect progression.
* An onsite, collaborative working environment in Navi Mumbai where you can learn closely with Account Executives and sales leadership through real prospect conversations.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to build deeper expertise in B2B SaaS outbound sales, executive engagement, qualification, demo coordination, and structured follow\-up.
